tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rtsa gsum gyi dril sgrub tshe g.yang 'gug pa'i rim pa 'dod dgu'i bum bzang bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru ha s+ya badz+ra ye/ gar dbang rdo rje 'chang chen dkyil 'khor gtso// rgyal kun skyed yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// e waṃ gnyis med bde chen zung 'jug sku// dpal ldan bla ma mchog gis skyong gyur cig / 'dir rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bzhad pa rdo rje dang*/ yi dam lhan cig skyes ma la brten nas mchog sgrub pa/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med dang bka' srung lha sman rgyal mo mched lnga la brten nas tshe dpal bskyed cing rma g.yang 'gugs pa'i rim pa la/ dang po sgrub pa po sdom pa dam tshig la gnas shing bstan dang bla mar gus pa/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor zhugs shing smin sgrol gyis rgyud brlan pa dag gis yar ngo'am tshes brgyad dang*/ bcu/ bco lnga la sogs pa dus khyad par can la/ grub thob gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dben gnas/ gangs dang rdza ri g.ya' spang sman dang me tog gi ljongs sam/ nags tshal dang chu bo'i ngogs sogs gang yang rung bar gnas khang mdzes par brgyan la/ dkon mchog rtsa gsum gyi rten bkram pa'i mdun du/ stegs bu gru bzhi par ba byung lnga dang ma da nas chags chags gdab cing*/ tshon gyi chos 'byung dmar po bsnol ma mu khyud dkar po can gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog lte bar gri gug /shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri bkod/ de'i phyir thod phreng dang*/ rdo ra me ris bskor ba rdul tshon nam ras bris gang rung gi steng*/ mañji'i khar rin po che'i bum pa rgyan dang ldan pa lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang rgyun 'bab chus sum gnyis bskang*/ dar dmar gyi mgul chings dang*/ kha rgyan dung chos gzungs rdor bkod/ mthar mchod pa bdun gyis bskor/ g.yas su dar dmar gyi steng du 'bru tshom la tshe gtor bum gzugs rgyan ldan/ tshe ril dang tshe chang*/ g.yon du dar dkar po'i steng*/ g.yung drung dmar po g.yon 'khyil lnga tshom bris pa'i steng du 'bru'i tshom bu bkod la/

'bru dkar sna tshogs pa'i phye ma rin po che'i rigs dang sman sna bsres pa/ ba dkar ra dkar sogs kyi 'o mas sbrus pa'i lha mo lnga'i gtor ma dpe'u ris ltar bshams pa'i steng du dar dkar gyi gur phub/ spod sna tshogs btab pa'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'brang rgyas/ dkar mo'i lag g.yas dang*/ lhang dkar gyi sha /dkar gsum dang mngar gsum/ ja chang*/ khur ba dang*/ shing tog sogs mdor na zas sna tshogs pas mthar bskor zhing mda' rgod sgro ma dar sna lnga'i cod pan can me long sor gdub btags pa'i mgul du/ rin po che'i za ma tog /mu tig /g.yu/ mgron bu/ mu men sogs rin po che'i rigs dang*/ sin+dhu ra/ bzang drug sogs sman snas bskang ba bdog cing*/ gzhan yang bla rdo rten rdzas gang 'byor dang*/ mthar nyer spyod bdun gyi mchod pa dang*/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun sogs bris 'bur gang rung*/ 'og tu dgos pa'i gtor 'bul rnams dang*/ gser skyems/ phye mar/ 'bru sna/ sman sna/ dar sna spos sna sogs mchod rdzas rnam pa ji snyed rgya che zhing yid du 'ong ba gang dag tshar du dngar bar bshams/ sgrub po'i mdun du g.yon nas brtsams te/ lag mchod kyi ka pā la bdud rtsi'i ril bu dang ldan pa myos byed kyis gtams pa/ ḍā dril rnams bkod/ gzhan yang rol mo'i rigs sogs ci rigs par 'du byas la/ gnyis pa nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdag nyid skad cig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// lhan cig skyes ma'i ngo bor gsal bar gyur// oṃ āḥbigh+nān gyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ ram̐ kam̐ rnams las// rlung me'i dkyil 'khor thod sgyed gsum gyi steng*// a las ka pā la yi snod yangs par// bi mu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga// go ku da ha na las sha lnga ste// slar yang so sor yi ges mtshan pa'o// rlung bskyod me sbar bcud khol de steng du// 'bru gsum 'od 'phros ye shes bdud rtsi bkug

/dam tshig bdud rtsi dbyer med ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zag med rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pa sngon gtor btang ba ni/ sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs la 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ gyis spyan drangs la/ pad skor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ḥbam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+wam̐ḥ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes pa lan gsum mam bzhi 'am lnga brjod/ so so'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra paṣ+pe= dhu pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai bi d+ya= shab+da āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ pad kor dang rdor thal kha gyen pas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhu ta pre ta pi sha tsa ub+da da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i dam+ba ling gṛh+nan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid dhi m+mai pra yats+tshan+tu ya the baṃ ya theṣ+ṭaṃḥbhāñja tha dzi gha tha pi pa tha ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sā hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan bzhir brjod/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gnyan skyong zhal bzhes pa// rdo rje'i dam ldan zhing skyong chen po brgyad// rdo rje mkha' 'gro so gnyis 'khor tshogs bcas// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bdag gi mchod sbyin gyi// dngos bshams yid sprul gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag 'khor bcas rnams dpal grags dbang phyug cing*// tshe ring nad med las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol// skal pa bzang spel dge ba'i stong grogs mdzod// gang dag dkyil 'khor lta bar mi dbang ba'i// log 'dren bdud tshogs ma gnas gzhan du dengs// gal te bka' 'das rdo rje kha ṭām̐ gas// lus srog rdul phran thal bar brlag ta re// zhes gtor ma phyir phul/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad la/ rdo rje gsor zhing yungs kar brab/ gu gul bdug /bzhi pa srung 'khor ni/

steng 'og phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i gur bla bre// rwa ba drwa ba sa gzhi'i rnam par gyur// phra men rnams kyis dkyil 'khor sgo mtshams bsdoms// srung dang zlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bsgom mo// lnga pa skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa ni/ na mo/ bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// ye shes chos skyong ḍā ki la// sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi// sems can bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// dga' dang btang snyoms cher gnas shog / lan gsum mam bdun brjod/ drug pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān gyi sa bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la// yangs shing rgya chen rnams kyi nang du hūm̐// dpag med 'od zhu lha rdzas las grub pa'i// rdo rje'i mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas sgra snyan sogs// gtor tshogs brten rdzas phyi nang gsang ba yi// mchod sprin zag med bde chen skyed byed pa// dwangs shing thogs med mkha' dbyings gang bar gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes byin brlabs la/ bdun pa tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal snying ga yi// sa bon 'od kyis bla ma bcom ldan ma// sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs dang bcas pa rnams// mdun mkhar spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo sbyar la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs bdun rnam dag dang rgyun bshags bya/ tshogs zhing 'od zhu rang dang dbyer med gyur// de nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom la/ brgyad pa bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa ni/ oṃ swa bha sogs dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khams gsum po// thams cad chos 'byung gzhal yas khang*// de dbus pad+ma ro yi steng*// rang sems hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros// 'phags mchod sems can don byas 'dus// yongs gyur bdag nyid rnal 'byor ma// chos sku nyag gcig zhal gcig ma// thabs shes zung 'jug phyag gnyis ma// bdud dpung 'jigs byed khro gnyer can// mche gtsigs tshems kyis ma mchu mnan// dmar la g.yo zlum spyan gsum 'bar/

dbu skra kham nag 'bar zhing grol// thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan can// 'du byed dag pa'i rang bzhin gyis// thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang*/ me tog dril bu g.yer khas brgyan// phyin drug rus rgyan phyag rgya lnga// rdo rje gri gug thod khrag bsnams// rus pa'i kha ṭ+wām̐ gru mor brten// g.yon brkyang gar gyi rnam par rol// stong gsum khyab cing 'od 'bar ba'o// de yi spyi bo mgrin pa dang*// snying ga lte ba gsang gnas su// seng ge rma bya glang chen dang*// rta mchog shang shang gis btegs khrir// sna tshogs rin chen las grub steng*// pad+ma stong ldan zla dkyil dbus// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥrnams las// bcom ldan rigs lnga tshe dpag med// sku mdog dkar dmar mthing ser ljang*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis tshe bum 'dzin// pad+ma'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan dang*// mgul rgyan phyag zhabs gdub bus mdzes// le rgan dar gyi stod g.yogs dang*// smad g.yogs zhabs gnyis rdor skyil bzhugs// 'od dang 'od zer 'bar ba ru// snang stong chu zla lta bur gsal// rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dkar// dri med 'dab brgya'i ge sar dbus// thabs shes nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor steng*// rtsa brgyud bla ma kun 'dus pa// rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje ni// zhi 'dzum phyag g.yas snyan la brten// g.yon pas ba men rwa yi snod/ bdud rtsis gtams pa thugs kar bsnams// lcang lo phod kha ling nge ba// sku la ras dkar bla gos gsol// zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs// de yi spyi bor 'ja' 'od klong*// rma bya brgyad stegs rin chen khrir// chags med pad+ma zla ba'i steng*// de bzhin gshegs pa snang mtha' yas// dmar gsal mnyam bzhag lhung bzed bsnams// sprul sku'i cha lugs mtshan dpe rdzogs// bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// ḍā ki chos skyong sprin ltar gtibs// de ltar bskyed pa'i lugs dkyil gyi// gnas gsum 'bru gsum sa bon las// 'od 'phros nub phyogs o rgyan dang*// bde chen pad+mo bkod pa'i zhing*// rang bzhin rnam dag dkyil 'khor nas// bsgom pa dang 'dra'i ye shes pa// sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang*// rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor tshogs bcas// dpag tu med pa spyan drangs gyur// gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

zhes spyan drangs/ de rnams sku las sku mang 'phros// lus thim bde dang drod nus bskyed// gsung la ā li kā li 'phros// ngag thim mthu dang nus pa bskyed// thugs las byang sems chu rgyun babs// yid thim bde stong ting 'dzin bskyed// lha rnams rang rang so sor thim// gnyis med rigs bdag dbu brgyan pa'o// zhes dam tshig par ye shes gnyis med du bstim nas/ dgu pa bzlas pa'i rim pa ni/ gsang bar chos 'byung pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus// hrīḥdang 'dab bzhir ha ri ni sa ste// hrīḥlas sngags phreng g.yon du bskor ba la// don kun 'grub byed 'khor lo 'od 'bar ba'o// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gang nus bzla zhing*/ spyi bo'i rje btsun rin po cher gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rgyal dbang brgyad pas mdzad pa'i/ byang phyogs mun pa'i smag rum na// gangs la nyi ma shar 'dra ba'i// thos pa dga' zhes bya ba yi// skyes bu de la gus phyag 'tshal// byang phyogs rgyud du sku 'khrungs shing*// 'jig rten skyon gyis ma gos par// dka' ba spyad pa'i ngo mtshar can// mi la mchog la gsol ba 'debs// bde chen brjod med ro yis myos// srid gsum dag pa'i phyag rgyas bcings// bsreg bzhu'i lam nas lhan cig skyes// mi la mchog la= rags snang phra thig zab mor bsten// phra myong bdag byin brlabs par mdzad// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rigs kyi bdag /mi la mchog la= 'dzag med gtso mor sa bon bkrol// srid bdag lam du snying rjes len// nus pa drag po'i skur bzhengs pa// mi la mchog la= bdag kyang 'khor ba mi spang zhing*// myang 'das zhi bar mi 'jug ste// mkha' spyod dbang phyug mi la yi// mchog gi dngos grub 'grub gyur cig / sogs mthar chags su brjod/ oṃ āḥgu ru ha s+ya badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes mtshan sngags bzlas la gdung shugs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa rje sgam po pas mdzad pa ni/

bla ma rje btsun rin po che/ bdag gi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa dang*/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa thams cad da lta nyid du dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ thun 'di nyid du dag par byin gyis brlab= bla ma rje btsun rin po che/ bdag gi rgyud 'di dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rgyud 'di rnam par grol bar byin gyis brlab tu= da lta nyid du grol bar byin= 'dug sa 'di nyid du grol bar byin gyis= thun 'di nyid du grol bar byin gyis= bla ma rje btsun rin po che/ bdag gi rgyud la ting nge 'dzin phyin ci ma log pa mchog tu gyur pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ da lta nyid du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du skye bar byin gyis= thun 'di nyid du skye bar byin gyis brlab= bla ma rje btsun rin po che/ bdag gi rgyud la phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes phyin ci ma log pa mchog tu gyur pa skye bar byin= da lta nyid du skye bar byin gyis= 'dug sa 'di nyid du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ thun 'di nyid du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te rang gi gnas bzhi gang*/ dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi dag nas sku bzhi'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag par gyur/ yang 'od dpag med la yid rtse gcig tu gus pa'i blos sngags kyis gsol ba btab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sa ra ha/ ka ra re/ sha ra re hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun nam nyer gcig skabs dang bstun par brjod la/ rje karma chags med pas mdzad pa'i bzlas dmigs 'di bzhin 'don sgom sbrags/ spyi bo'i 'od dpag med las 'od zer 'phros// snang srid 'khor 'das tshe dang bsod nams kun// 'od kyis bsdus nas lhung bzed nang du thim// lhung bzed nang nas tshe yi bdud rtsi 'phyur// mi la'i tshangs bug nas zhugs rang lus gang*// rang gi gnas lnga'i tshe dpag rigs lnga las// rang mdog 'od 'phros rigs lnga'i rigs gyur pa'i// tshe yi dngos grub bsdus te rang la thim// 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par gyur// oṃ a mā ra ni dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/

gang 'grub dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi ta ā ur+dz+nya na su bi nish+tsi ta te dz+wa ra dza ya/ ta thā ga tā yār+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye ma hā puṇ+ye a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ kā ra pa ri shud+dhe dharma te ga ga na sa mud ga te swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/

tshe gzungs kyang bzla'o// mthar/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// mi yi seng ge sbyin pa'i stobs rtogs te// snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa na// sbyin pa mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog /tshul khrims stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// mi yi seng ge tshul khrims stobs rtogs te// snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa na// tshul khrims mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog /bzod pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// mi yi seng ge bzod pa'i stobs rtogs te// snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa na// bzod pa mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog /brtson 'grus stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// mi yi seng ge brtson 'grus stobs rtogs te// snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa na// brtson 'grus mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog /bsam gtan stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// mi yi seng ge bsam gtan stobs rtogs te// snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa na// bsam gtan mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog /shes rab stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// mi yi seng ge shes rab stobs rtogs te// snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa na// shes rab mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog / sogs brjod par bya'o// bcu pa mdun bskyed yi dam bsgrub pa ni/ bigh+nān gyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi mkhar// e las chos 'byung gzhal yas khang*// de dbus pad+ma ro yi steng*// yi ge hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros// 'phags mchod sems can don byas 'dus// yongs gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// chos sku nyag gcig zhal gcig ma// thabs shes zung 'jug phyag gnyis ma// bdud dpung 'jigs byed khro gnyer can// mche gtsigs tshems kyis ma mchu mnan// dmar la g.yo zlum spyan gsum 'bar// dbu skra kham nag 'bar zhing grol// thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan can// 'du byed dag pa'i rang bzhin gyi// thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyangs// me tog dril bu g.yer khas brgyan// phyin drug rus rgyan phyag rgya lnga// rdo rje gri gug thod khrag bsnams// rus pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten// g.yon brkyang gar gyi rnam par rol// stong gsum khyab cing 'od 'bar ba'o// phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa las// shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngo// lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ser// nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar// byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang*// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang*// ral gris mtshan pa'i gri thod 'dzin// kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan bcug rgyan cha lugs// yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur// gtso mo'i gsang gnas chos 'byung dbus// hrīḥdang mkha' 'gro bzhi'i thugs ka'i// sa bon rnams las 'od 'phros pas// o rgyan gnas nas bcom ldan ma// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs gyur// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da pra tits+tsha swā hā/ pañca a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ma taṅgi āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ hūm̐ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i ngang*// skye ba med pa sprul pa'i sku// snying rje'i dbang gis byung ba yi// bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar// mtshal dang sin+dhu ra ltar mdzes// g.yas pas gri gug g.yon thod khrag /thabs kyi rang bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon// shes rab lnga dang ye shes lngas// rab brgyan sku gsum tshul du bzhugs// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer ldan// bcu drug lo lon gzhon cing sgeg /'bar ba yi ni gar dgur ldan// spyan gsum po la mche ba bzhi// cung zad gtsigs shing khro mo'i zhal// gcer bu dbu skra grol zhing gnag /dbu la thod skam lnga yis brgyan// thod rlon gyi ni do shal byas// rus pa dang ni rin po ches// brgyan cing dar gyi cod pan thogs// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong*// sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan// gnyis med g.yas brkyang gar gyis gnas// dus mtshan ro yi lte bar mnan// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi gtso mo ste// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa// ci bsam pa yi don rnams kun// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen mo yis// dus 'di nyid du bdag la stsol// ces pas bstod/ de rnams sku las sku mang 'phros// lus thim bde dang drod nus bskyed// gsum las ā li kā li 'phros// ngag thim mthu dang nus pa bskyed// thugs las byang sems chu rgyun babs// yid thim bde stong ting 'dzin bskyed// lha rnams rang rang so so la// thim pas gnyis su med par gyur// ces brjod la/ bzlas pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcu gcig pa bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān gyis bsangs/

swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ yig yongs gyur las// rin chen pad+ma rā ga las grub pa'i// bkra shis bum bzang mchu 'phyang lto ba ldir// zhabs zhum mgrin ring mgul chings le brgan dar// dpag bsam shing lo me tog kha rgyan mdzes// nang du lnga phrag lnga yi rdzas rnams dang*// lha yi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin chus bskang dbus// paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab stong ldan// ge sar 'dzum phreng sdong bu yal ga dang*// lo 'dab kun tu rgyas pa de yi steng*// a las chu shel zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni// cha shas yongs gang lte bar hrīḥ dmar po// de las 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs// 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las// rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid// tshe dang ye shes dpag med mgon po mchog /sku mdog 'char ka'i nyin byed ltar dmar ba// mtshan dper rab rdzogs 'od dang 'od zer 'bar// zhi 'dzum zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag rgyas// tshe yi bum pa bdud rtsi'i bcud gtams 'dzin// rat+na'i dbu rgyan snyan cha mgul chu dang*// do shal se mo do dang phyag zhabs gdub// dar la'i stod g.yogs smad g.yogs zhabs rdor skyil// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur gsal gnas gsum du// oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing thugs ka'i dbus// zla steng hrīḥdamar de las 'od zer 'phros// bskyed pa dang 'dra'i ye shes 'khor lo'i tshogs// mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs gsal bar gyur// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da sogs kyis mchod pa dang*/ hrīḥbacom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med// mkha' mnyam sku gsung thugs mnga' ba// rnam dag sku gsung thugs su ldan// tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ dzaḥ hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥye shes dam tshig pa// dbyer med gyur cing slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥ// de las 'od 'phros dbang lha rigs lnga'i tshogs/

rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs mchod par gyur// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ sogs nas/ shab+da 'i bar dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣañca tu maṃ// gsol btab mod la de bzhin gshegs pa dang*// gshegs ma rnams kyis dbang bskur sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs ye shes bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur// sku gang chu zhabs spyi bor brten pa las// rigs bdag 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan cing*// bum lha'i thugs kar rin chen za ma tog /dbus su hrīḥdamar de las sngags phreng bskor// tha mar bdag dang bsrung bya'i ming bcas gsal// thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig /tshe dang ye shes kun nas rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ sa ra ha/ ka ra re/ sha ra re hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum/ bdag dang bsrung bya deng nas bzung ste mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i skyabs 'og tu tshud par gyur cig /bdag la ring po'i mchog thob par gyur cig /tshe srog brag las sra bar gyur cig /tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par gyur cig /mi rgyud chu las ring bar gyur cig /lcags kyi srog rtsa 'grub par gyur cig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig /'chi med tshe yi g.yung drung thob par gyur cig / ces gsol ba btab/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gzungs thag brgyud// bum lhar thim pa'i 'od kyis rgyal ba mchod// thugs rje byin rlabs brtan g.yo snang srid kyi// yon tan bdud rtsi'i dwangs bcud bum lha yi/ shangs bug nas zhugs sngags phreng ming yig la// thim pas bdag dang bsgrub bya'i lus ngag yid// gzhom med rtag pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyur//

de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ gang 'grub bzlas la/ na mo bha ga wa te a pa ra mi ta sogs gzungs ring bzla'o// bcu gnyis pa tshe 'gugs pa ni/ bdag dang bum lha'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i tshe bcud thams cad bsdus par bsam nas tshe yi mda' dar g.yab cing*/ hūm̐ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med// 'byung ba lnga la dbang bsgyur lha mo'i tshogs// bdag dang bsrung bya'i tshe dang g.yang spel cig /steng 'og phyogs bcu snod kyi 'jig rten la// bros dang 'khyams dang yar ba'i tshe khug cig /stong phrag brgyad cu bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kyis/ brkus dang 'phrog dang gzhom pa'i tshe khug cig /'byung ba'i dgra gshed 'khrugs pa'i las sbyor gyis// nyams dang zad dang 'thor ba'i tshe bsos shig /had kyis bsngangs dang yid kyis brgyal ba dang*// 'ud kyis 'grogs pa'i tshe dang g.yang gsos shig /tshe khug g.yang skyob dngos grub bstsal du gsol// 'byung lnga 'od lnga 'bar ba'i tshe bcud bstims// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes bskul zhing*/ sngags ni/ a ghu sa ma ya e h+ye ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐/ zhes bzla/ de nas rgyas gdab pa ni/ dang po rtse gcig sems kyi rgya// gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya// gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya// bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya// lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya// drug pa rta mgrin dbang gi rgya// bdun pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya// rgya bdun rim gyis btab pa la// su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ de nas tshe sba ba ni/ ā chos kyi dbyings su tshe sbas pas// sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs na// gnod byed bgegs kyis lta ci smos// de phyir rdo rje'i tshe sba'o// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐// zhes brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta āḥyuḥde wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/

de bzhin rigs 'gres/ shab+da bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba// sku mchog rnam par dag pa'i sku// mnyam nyid sku la phyag 'tshal lo// gsung mchog rnam par dag pa'i gsung*// gsung rab dam pa spros dang bral// yi ge med cing sgra spangs pa// spros med gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs nyid rnam par dag pa'i thugs// thugs mchog rnam par rtog pa spangs// chags med ye shes mkhyen pa ste// stong nyid thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod la/ bum lha bcom ldan mgon po 'od zhu nas// 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rnam par gyur// dung chos kyi chu bum par blugs/ bcu gsum pa bka' srung lha sman rgyal mo 'khor bcas bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan gyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ mdun gyi sa gzhir srid pa'i rdul brtsegs kai la sha yi ri// dwangs gsal chu shel mdangs 'tsher bdud rtsi'i char rgyun rtag tu 'bebs// g.ya' dang rdza brag rnam mang an+dha snyil mtshungs spang gi ljongs// marga ta bzhin yid dbang brtas byed sman gyi skyed mos tshal// me tog sna tshogs rnam par bkra zhing dri bsung ngad ldang ba// lo 'dab 'bras bzang khur gyis dud pa'i rkang 'thung ljon pa dang*// pad+mas brgyan pa'i mtsho dang rdzing bu dag byed gtsang ma'i chab// dal bar 'babs pa'i 'gram ngogs ngang pa la sogs 'phur lding g.yo// ca co'i glu dbyangs snyan pas sgra 'dzin sim pa ster bar byed// mkha' yi glang po lang ling kun tu dkrigs shing bsil ba sbyin// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams 'ja' 'od kha dog lnga ldan lam me ba// de lta'i ri dbang rab brjid spo mtho'i g.yon gyi grwa zur mgul// lha rdzas rin thang bral ba'i dar dkar dri med yangs pa'i gur// za 'og gser gyi re khā rnam par bkra ba'i yol ba dang*// tsan+dan dkar dang dmar ba'i tshugs shing dar sngon chon thag la// gser dang dngul gyi phur btab gzhan yang sa gsum 'jig rten gyi// mkho dgu'i longs spyod ngo mtshar khyad 'phags du mas dpa' ba ste// phyi ltar bkod legs yon tan rmad byung phun sum tshogs pa dang*// nang ltar rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang dam pa dngos// gsang ba ltar na don dam e yig rdo rje btsun mo'i dbyings// de yi dbus su paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan// bkra gsal dkyil 'khor lnga po so sor gsal bar gyur ba yi// dbus su dung gi seng lcam dkar mo g.yu yi ral pa can// rin chen gser dang dar zab 'phyang 'phrul dril bu g.yer khas brgyan// de yi steng du rigs 'dus sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid// gtso mo lha sman rgyal mo bkra shis tshe yi dbang phyug ma// sku mdog dkar gsal ston ka'i zla ba cha shas yongs gang bzhin// rab tu mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu nam mkhar phyar ba yis// tshe yi bar chad bsrung zhing g.yon pas rin chen bum pa bzang*// 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsis bkang ba dpal be'u g.yung drung dang*// dga' 'khyil gyis brgyan thugs kar 'dzin pas sgrub por dngos grub ster// thor tshugs rtse mor dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil bas mdzes par brgyan// shar du rkyang bu kha dkar la gnas badz+ra ḍā ki ma// mthing gi zhal bzang dbang sngon mdangs ldan phyag g.yas ā dar sha

/snang srid gsal ston g.yon pas dar dkar ba dan phyar stabs 'dzin// rin chen in+d+ra'i thor tshugs dang ldan dgyes pa'i zhal mdangs mnga'// lho ru rgya stag grus ma la gnas rat+na ḍā ki ma// mi g.yo blo bzang btso ma gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yas pas// rin chen snod du lha yi zhal zas bsod cing ro brgyar ldan// g.yos pas ne'u le bsnams shing ka na ka yi thor tshugs can// nub tu gser sha yu mo la gnas pad+ma ḍā ki ma// cod pan mgrin bzang pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs phyag g.yas kyis// dgos 'byung nor bu dbang rgyal g.yon pas rin chen za ma tog /mos pa rnam bzhi dbang du bsgyur cing byu ru'i thor tshugs mdzes// byang du g.yu 'brug sngon mo la gnas karma ḍā ki ma// gtad dkar 'gro bzang margad kha dog 'chang zhing phyag g.yas pa// rtsa mchog dūr+wa'i chun po g.yon pas lto 'gro'i zhags pa bsnams// phrin las thogs med myur bar ston cing g.yu yi thor tshugs ldan// kun kyang zhi ma khro 'dzum mtshar sdug 'od du 'bar ba can// dar dkar go zu ya mtshan dbang po'i tshon ris dang ldan pa// man+t+ri la sogs na bza' sum brtsegs lhab lhub sku la gsol// lha yi reg bya pañca li ka'i stod g.yogs rnam par bkra// rin thang bral ba'i lha dang klu dbang mi yi nor bu ni// sna tshogs dag gis prog zhu snyan dang mgul rgyan dpung gdub spras// do shal se mo do dang mu tig chun 'phyang dril g.yer phreng*// zhabs gdub la sogs rgyan mdzes 'ja' 'od zer gsum klong du gsal// bskyed pa'i yab yum ming po bdun dang brtan skyong bcu gnyis po// gzhan yang las dang 'jig rten dpa' bo ḍā ki sman mo'i tshogs// bye ba 'bum sde snang zhing srid pa'i sde brgyad yul lha dang*// gnas dang gter bdag dge bsnyen 'khor tshogs rang rang rigs mthun sde// rgyan dang cha lugs sna tshogs ston cing dpung tshogs du mas bskor bar bskyed// de ltar gtso 'khor rnams kyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan pa dang*// rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul bskyed pa dang 'dra'i lha// 'brog chen la phyi gangs kyi ra ba'i gnas mchog dam pa nas// gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur//

de nas rje gar dbang drug pas bstsal ba'i spyan 'dren sogs kyi rim pa las gzhung sor bzhag las/ bcu bzhi pa spyan drangs pa dang bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ spos dkar gyi dud pa dang rol mo sna tshogs bsgrag la/ sngon tshe dur khrod bsil tshal du// mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can gyi// spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes pa'i// mkha' 'gro lnga po gnas 'dir gshegs// sngon tshe kha la rong sgo ru// o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes pa'i// mkha' 'gro lnga po gnas 'dir gshegs// sngon tshe sman lung chu bar du/ dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje yi// spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes pa'i// mkha' 'gro lnga po gnas 'dir gshegs// phyi ltar sman btsun chen mo lnga// nang ltar zhing skyong chen mo lnga// gsang ba rigs kyi yum chen lnga// gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// sde brgyad du ma'i 'khor dang bcas// rnal 'byor sgrub po 'khor bcas la// thugs dam brtse bas dgongs mdzod la// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bh+yo/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs nas// bal bod gnyis kyi sa mtshams na// gangs dkar shel gyi cod pan can// phu chu snyan pa'i rgyun sgra can// nags ma me tog sham bu can// g.ya' spang g.yu yi ska rags can// sman ljongs brag gi ra ba can// gnas mchog de 'dra'i g.yon mgul nas// rin chen sna lnga'i khri steng na// bkra shis tshe yi dbang phyug ma// drag po'i gdung bas khyod 'bod na// de ring sgrub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir// lhab lhub na bza'i rgyan dang bcas// sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// nam mkha'i mthongs nas spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol// añjī'i dhā ri'i rigs kyi ḍā ki ma// kun gyis gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// de yi mched zla za byed chen mo bzhi// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi añji dhā ri pañca ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ

gnyis su med par gyur// gangs dkar rin chen gzhal yas khang*// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du// lha sman 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// bar chad sol la dngos grub zhu// jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma mkha' 'gro lnga 'khor rgya mtsho dang bcas/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge gdong can dang*/ tā ma la ri khrod ma dang*/ gtum mo dang*/ sngo sangs ma dang*/ bi na mo badz+ra dang*/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ dpal bzhad pa rdo rje la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ bstan 'dzin gyi bu slob skyong*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ log 'dren gdug pa can rnams kyi bsam pa ngan pa dang*/ sbyor ba rtsub pa thams cad thal ba'i rdul bzhin du brlag pa dang*/ bdag cag gi bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub cing chos ldan gyi bya ba mthar phyin pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu thob pa'i phrin las mdzod cig / ces brjod la ḍā ki lnga'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag /lcer bdud rtsir byin/ dam la bzhag pa'i mos pas/ oṃ añjī dha ri pañca ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya ma nu sma ra ya sa ma ya mā ti kra ma ti sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ zhes brjod/ skabs 'dir bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod na/ ḍā ki lnga po so so'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rim bzhin oṃ ha ri nī sa'i sa bon las rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ par bsam la/ oṃ a ka ni tsa li mi thu phri li re swā hā/ oṃ ḍā ki ni kan+t+ra pa ni ma ra ya dzaḥswā hā/ oṃ na tri ma tri du ru ma tri swā hā/ oṃ ḍā ki sa pa ri tsakra mu ni tiṣ+ṭha rbad lo swā hā/ oṃ a ni ni ma ta ra ki ni mi thu phri li ri ye swā hā/ bco lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ oṃ nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na// gangs dkar dgung du rtse mtho ba// mtho la gnyen no tshe ring ma// rdo rje mi 'gyur dpal gyi yum// na bza' dkar mo tshe yi lha// lhan skyes yum la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma// mchog gi dngos grub gnang mdzad ma// rdo rje khros ma zhes su grags// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// lha mo mi g.yo blo bzang ma// dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bebs mdzad ma// rdo rje bzhad ma zhes su grags// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// lha mo cod pan mgrin bzang ma// tshe yi dngos grub gnang mdzad ma// rdo rje dpal mo zhes su grags// pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// lha mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma// drag po'i dngos grub gnang mdzad ma// rdo rje gar mkhan zhes su grags// las kyi mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// gzi brjid dpal dang 'od du 'bar// rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs bdag mo ste// rdo rje mi 'gyur dpal gyi yum// gtso mo lnga po 'khor dang bcas// ma mo sman mo 'bum gyis bskor// mchod gtor bzang po 'di bzhes la// rdo rje 'chang dang thod phreng rtsal// bzhad pa rdo rje'i thugs rje yi// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bla ma'i sku tshe khyod kyis bsrings// sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis srungs// sgrub pa'i bar chad khyod kyis sol// bdud dang mu stegs khyod kyis thul// yon bdag rkyen ngan khyod kyis srungs// yul phyogs kun tu bde legs spel// oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hā hā ho ho pheṃ pheṃ phaṭa/

/oṃ ā badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// yum chen shes rab pha rol phyin// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas// dar dkar g.yab cing g.yang du len// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag tshe srog bskyab tu gsol// 'og min chos dbyings gzhal yas nas// bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad dang*// sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams// dar dkar g.yab cing g.yang du len// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// bya rgod phung po'i ri bo nas// bcom ldan shā kya thub pa dang*// nyan thos chen po mchog brgyad rnams// dar dkar g.yab cing g.yang du len// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// seng ge bsnol ba'i khri steng du// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng na// bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad ni// sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro// phyag na gser gyi bum pa bsnams// zhal nas g.yang rab dam pa 'don// oṃ shrī badz+ra bai ro tsa na rat+na sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bde ldan skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// 'di nas shar phyogs zhing khams na// glang chen bsnol ba'i khri steng du// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng na// rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor bcas ni// sku mdog dkar gsal rgyan dang ldan// phyag na gser gyi lhung bzed bsnams// zhal nas g.yang rab dam pa 'don// oṃ badz+ra rat+na hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bde ldan skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// 'di nas lho phyogs rol pa na// rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na// rta mchog bsnol ba'i khri steng du// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng na// bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan ni// sku mdog gser gyi lhun po 'dra// phyag na g.yang gi dung zhal bsnams// zhal nas g.yang rab dam pa 'don// oṃ badz+ra ā badz+ra rat+na sarba bha wa hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/

dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// bdag cag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na// rma bya bsnol ba'i khri steng du// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng na// bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med// tshe la dbang ba'i lha dang bcas// sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'bar// phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams// zhal nas g.yang rab dam pa 'don// oṃ āḥbadz+ra a mṛ ta pad+ma saṃ bha wa hūm̐ hrī ṭhāḥ/ dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// bdag cag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// byang gi phyogs na bzhugs pa ni// shang shang bsnol ba'i khri steng na// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng na// bcom ldan don yod grub pa ni// ljang khu īn+d+ra nī la'i mdog /phrin las grub pa'i lha dang bcas// phyag na g.yu yi lhung bzed ni// rin chen g.yang gis gang ba bsnams// zhal nas g.yang rab dam pa 'don// oṃ āḥ.a mo gha kar+m+ma sid+dhi sarba dzaḥhūm̐ hrī ṭhā/ dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// bdag cag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// dbus kyi gtso la bzhugs pa ni// gtsug tor dkar mo lha mo ni// sku mdog dkar mo gangs ri 'dra// dbu stong spyan gyis kun tu gzigs// phyag mtshan rnam grangs stong dang ldan// thugs rje 'gro ba kun la snyoms// mi dang nor gyi bdag po ste// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid rtag gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// shar gyi phyogs na bzhugs pa ni// rdo rje gtsug tor lha mo ste// phyag na rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams// g.yon na g.yu yi dril bu gsil// bde ldan skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bdag cag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// lho yi phyogs na bzhugs pa ni// rin chen gtsug tor lha mo che// phyag na yid bzhin nor bu bsnams// gser gyi dril bu gsung snyan sgrog

/mi g.yang sdud pa'i bdag mo ste// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// bdag cag mi g.yang bskyab tu gsol// nub kyi phyogs na bzhugs pa ni// pad+ma gtsug tor lha mo ste// phyag na pad+ma 'dab brgyad bsnams// g.yon na g.yang gi zhags pa bsnams// phyug g.yang sdud pa'i bdag mo ste// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag phyug g.yang bskyab tu gsol// byang gi phyogs na bzhugs pa ni// las kyi gtsug tor lha mo che// phyag na rdo rje rgya gram bsnams// g.yon pa 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin// lo g.yang sdud pa'i bdag mo ste// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// bdag cag lo g.yang bskyab tu gsol// grwa yi phyogs ni kun tu yang*// rigs kyi yum dang gsang ba'i yum// dgos pa rnams ni ster ba dang*// lo tsā dang ni ma ma kī// dkar mo sgrol ma la sogs rnams// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// dum bu bzhi la g.yang rten gsol// lha yi dbang po brgya byin yang*// lha rnams kun la dbang bsgyur zhing*// pha rol chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad// lha bran mang por sgra sgrog cing*// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// yid bzhin nor bu g.yang du btags// g.yas pas lha yi pho brang du// bkra shis g.yang rnams brtan pa yi// don grub lha mo phrin las chu// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// gnas 'dir bsrung ba'i las mdzod cing*// de ring yon bdag 'khor bcas la// mi yi tshe dang nor gyi g.yang*// zas kyi bcud dang skom gyi bcud// rta phyugs srog chags kun gyi g.yang*// mi rnams kun la bskyab tu gsol// khyed cag kun la bde legs shog

/de dag sdig par ma gyur cig /nyi ma thams cad dge ba yin// rgyu skar thams cad bzang po yin// sangs rgyas thams cad rdzu 'phrul che// dgra bcom thams cad zag pa zad// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas// bdag cag rnams la bde legs shog / bcu dgu pa gsol ka bya ba ni/ 'bru sman rin chen zas sna tshogs/ chang phud bzang po dang sbyar bas mchod cing 'di skad du/ hūm̐ rdo rje mi 'gyur dpal gyi yum// sku mdog dkar mo gzhon tshul can// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje bsnams// g.yon pas tshe yi bum pa 'dzin// bum pa'i steng na dpal be'u dang*// g.yu drung rin chen 'khyil bas brgyan// lhab lhub na bza'i rgyan dang ldan// sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// rin chen du mas mdzes par brgyan// bkra shis tshe yi gtso mo ste// chibs su seng ge dkar mo chibs// gangs dkar stod na bzhugs pa mo// mchod gtor 'di bzhes dngos grub stsol// srid srung rigs rgyud 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// mchod do gtsang ma'i phud kyis mchod// lha mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma// rdo rje khros ma zhes su grags// sku mdog sngo bsangs 'tsher bag can// chibs su rkyang bu kha dkar chibs// phyag g.yas dngul dkar me long bsnabs// g.yon pas lha yi ba dan phyar// sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol// sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// mchod gtor 'di bzhes dngos grub stsol// snang gsal bden mthong pra yi dngos grub stsol// mchod do gtsang ma'i phud kyis mchod// lha mo mi g.yo blo bzang ma// gsang mtshan rdo rje bzhad pa mo// sku mdog ser mo gser gyi mdog /chibs su rgya stag khra bo chibs// phyag g.yas rin chen sder bzang nang*// lha yi zhal zas sna tshogs bsnams// g.yon pas ne'u le'i rkyal ba 'dzin// sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod cig /mchod gtor 'di bzhes dngos grub stsol// rma g.yang ro mchog zas kyi dngos grub stsol// mchod do gtsang ma'i phud kyi mchod// lha mo cod pan mgrin bzang ma// rdo rje dpal mo longs spyod yum// sku mdog dmar gsal mdangs dang ldan// chibs su sha ba yu mo chibs// phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu dang*// phyag g.yon rin chen sgrom bu bsnams// snang srid thams cad dbang bsdus la// rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las sgrubs// mchod gtor 'di bzhes dngos grub stsol// bang mdzod 'bru nor 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// mchod do gtsang ma'i phud kyis mchod// lha mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma// gsang mtshan rdo rje gar mkhan mo// sku mdog sngo ljang mdangs dang ldan// chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon mo chibs// phyag g.yas rtsa mchog dur+wā dang*// g.yon pas sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams// phrin las thogs pa med pa yi// mthu dang nus pa 'dir ston cig

/mchod gtor 'di bzhes dngos grub stsol// rkang bzhi rta phyugs 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// mchod do gtsang ma'i phud kyis mchod// nyi shu pa drag po'i phrin las bcol bar 'dod na/ dmar gtor gru gsum sha chang gis brgyan pa bshams/ oṃ a kā ro lan gsum brjod pas byin brlabs nas/ hūm̐ rdo rje mkha' 'gro khyed rnams ni// ye shes mkha' 'gro yin mod kyang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// sha za mkha' 'gro'i tshul ston ma// dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhing bcu sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig /chos khrims bstan pa snga ma la// rdo rje 'chang dang shāka thub kyis// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis srungs// chos khrims bstan pa bar ma la// gdong dmar bod kyi rgyal po yis// mtha' 'khob mun pa'i smag rum du// dam pa chos kyi khrims kyang btsugs// mkhan slob bcas pa spyan drangs tshe// khyed cag rnams kyis ma bzod nas// gung thang kha la rong sgo ru// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la// dngos su tho 'tshams byas pa'i tshe// zil gnon dam la btags pa yi// khas blangs dam bcas 'dor ram ci// ma g.yel ma g.yel mthu rtsal can// chos khrims bstan pa phyi ma la// chu bar dpal gyi pho brang du// dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje la// ting 'dzin drod nyul byas pa'i tshe// mi 'jigs seṅge'i nga ro yis// bden tshig chos kyi 'jam char phab// dad pa'i myu gu skyes pa'i tshe// bka' srung mkha' 'gror dam bcas nas// chos brgyud spel bar g.yar dam bcas// dam tshig nyams na dmyal bar 'gro// de bas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// bzhad pa rdo rje'i bka' bzhin du// bka' srung bka' yi bya ra mdzod// pho brang gangs kyi g.yon mgul du// ston zla ra ba'i yar ngo la// bro 'tshal 'gum du nye ba'i tshe// 'chi bdag chad pa su yis bzlog /rang byung sgrub pa'i dben gnas su// kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// tha mar 'byung ba rgyu yi gzhi// smon 'jug rnam gnyis su yis bskyed// yi dam lha dang su yis sprad// thugs kyi ngo bo su yis gnang*// de kun mdzad pa'i bka' drin can// spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs pa de// bzhad pa rdo rje ma lags sam// de yi bka' 'bangs bdag cag kyang*// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mi skyob na// bla ma'i bka' bstsal bcag gam ci// rang gi snying po rang 'dral lam// ma g.yel ma g.yel mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du ni// dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol// bsgral ba'i zhing bcu khyod kyis sgrol// sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis srungs// dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyod kyis bstod// rnal 'byor sgos dgra khyod kyis sgrol// lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus// 'byung bzhi'i bar chad khyod kyis sol// dug lnga'i rnam rtog zhi bar mdzod// ma hā sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hrīḥ

bh+yo/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ngang nyid las// thabs mkhas thugs rjes lha mo'i tshul bzung nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung zhing spel mdzad ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// dpon g.yog lngar bcas zhing skyong mkha' 'gro ma'i// 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'dir gshegs sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang*// dza gad sman phud mchod pa 'di bzhes la// snga bcol las rnams grub pa'i gtang rag dang*// da bcol bsgrub phyir gtor ma sman phud bzhes// rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag gi 'khor rnams kyi// tshe dang dpal 'byor bsam pa'i don rnams la// bar du gcod byed nad dang gdon bgegs dang*// mi dang 'byung po'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol// deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar// sa dang lam gyi yon tan bsgrub pa la// bar du gcod byed 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen 'dod dgu ma lus 'grub par mdzod// bstan dang bstan pa'i khur 'dzin skyes bu dang*// rnal 'byor 'gro don phyogs bcur 'phel ba dang*// gang la gang 'dul phrin las rnam pa bzhi// 'gro la phan bde 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod// dkar mo zhi byed gsal ston ma// sngon mo mchog ster gsal ston ma// ser mo rgyas byed gsal ston ma// dmar mo dbang byed gsal ston ma// ljang mo drag byed gsal ston ma// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis// gsang ba nang gi mchod pa dang*// bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang*// rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ dang*// dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// sdang bar byed pa'i dgra rnams sod// gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams choms// bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog tu gsol//

zhes dmar gtor phyi rol du bskyal lo// spro na 'khor brtan skyong bcu gnyis kyi gtor 'bul gter rnying las byung ba ltar bya ba ni/ gtor ma dang gser skyems bshams la/ a kā ro sa byin brlabs la/ hūṃ bka' yi tshogs dang bcas nyid du// khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams// 'dir byon dam bskang 'phrin las mdzod// bh+yo/ bdag nyid chen mo la sogs bdud mo bzhi// gangs dkar sha med la sogs gnod sbyin bzhi// kong btsun de mo la sogs sman mo bzhi// bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis la// slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// so sor mtshan btags rgyan dang cha lugs dang*// bzhon par bcas te bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod// sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig brtser dgongs la// bran dang g.yog 'khor mang po'i tshogs dang bcas// lhab lhub rin chen mang po'i rgyan dang bcas// 'dir gshegs dam skong mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes// bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis kyis// sngon gyis dam tshig de ltar dran gyis la// sman raka gtor ma'i mchod pa 'di bzhes nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa mtha' dag rgyas par mdzod// rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam pa bsgrub tu gsol// hūm̐ dpal chen khrag 'thung sprul pa mo// ye shes dbyings la rten 'brel tshul// phyogs ma bzhi dang mtshams ma bzhi// snying po'i ma mo chen po bzhi// ma rtogs rten 'brel bcu gnyis te// phyi rol brtan ma bcu gnyis po// kun kyang thugs kyi dbyings su gcig /bcu gsum sa dang lam gyi dngos// phyi nang gsang ba'i dga' ba bzhi// dbyer med ye shes bzhi dang bcas// bcu drug bdag nyid chen mo la// snang srid thams cad mchod do bzhes// lugs 'byung lugs ldog rten 'brel rnams// dga' bzhi'i ngo bor rnam dag nas// mthar thug rdo rje 'chang gi sa// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes su// mngon du gyur pa'i phrin las mdzod//

ces brjod de gtor ma dang gser skyems phul lo// nyer gcig pa bzlog bsgyur ni/ bh+yo/ mkha' 'gro chen mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// dpon g.yog lngar bcas zhing skyong mkha' 'gro dang*// sde brgyad la sogs bran g.yog pho nya'i tshogs// khyed rnams de ring mthu dang dpung bskyed la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i// byang chub bsgrub pa'i lam gyi mi mthun phyogs// 'gal rkyen ma lus zhi bar mdzad du gsol// mkha' 'gro chen mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma// khyed rnams de ring mthu dang dpung bskyed la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi ba dang*// stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi gnod pa bzlog /gtad khram ban sngags dmod mo rbod gtong dang*// 'jigs pa brgyad dang 'thab rtsod med par mdzod// tshe dang thar pa'i lam la bar gcod pa'i// bdud dang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa bzlog tu gsol// las dang nyon mongs bcas pa'i sdig pa dang*// bag chags 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sbyong du gsol// mkha' 'gro chen mo mi g.yo blo bzang ma// khyed rnams de ring mthu dang dpung bskyed la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub stsol// yid la 'dod dgu dar zhing rgyas par mdzod// mkha' 'gro chen mo cod pan mgrin bzang ma// khyed rnams de ring mthu dang dpung bskyed la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// 'gro ba kun gyi dpal dang 'byor pa dang*// 'jig rten khams kyi 'dod yon ma lus pa// khug cig bsdus shig rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzad du gsol// mkha' 'gro chen mo gtad dkar 'gros bzang ma// khyed rnams de ring mthu dang dpung bskyed la// bla ma'i sku dgra bstan pa bshig pa dang*// sems can 'tshe dang rnal 'byor bdag cag gi

/sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs// sod cing skrod cing rmugs shig rengs par mdzod// zung zhig gtubs shig myos dang rmongs par mdzod// shig cig choms shig rdul tsam med par mdzod// zo zhig 'thung zhig sha khrag tshogs la rol// dam nyams dgra bo pha rol gnas su sgrol// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i 'gro don 'phel ba dang*// rgyal khams bde zhing bkra shis chos 'phel dang*// rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzod// bud+dha ḍā ki ni ba tsakra khā hi/ badz+ra ḍā ki ni/ rat+na ḍā ki ni/ pad+ma ḍā ki ni/ karma ḍā ki ni ba tsakra khā hi/ zhes brjod/ nyer gnyis pa nor lha rnams la g.yang blan pa ni/ phye mar dang*/ gser skyems kyis mchod de 'di skad do// hūm̐ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni// gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir// rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi bka' nyan gsung sdod ni// ci 'dod re ba skong mdzad pa// mthu chen stobs dang ldan pa po// gnod sbyin sum khri drug stong la// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni// phye mar mda' dar rin chen dang*// bdud rtsi gser skyems sil snyan sogs// dkar mngar sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// nor gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// byang phyogs dkor mdzod pho brang nas// nor lha'i rgyal po rnam thos sras// gnod sbyin kun gyi gtso bo ste// sku la bse khrab 'bar ba gsol// phyag na ba dan rtse brgyad 'phyar// g.yon pas rin chen ne'u le 'dzin// gser gyi mchod rten ser po las// dgos 'dod rin chen char ltar 'bab// chibs su seng ge bsgyings par chibs// nor lha bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor// kun kyang rin chen rgyan cha can// lag tu rin chen ne'u le 'dzin// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// rin chen dngos grub bdag la stsol// oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya rat+na sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/

bcom ldan lha mo nor rgyun ma// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgya yis// 'jig pa brgyad skyob 'gro ba sdud// g.yon pa'i phyag gi thugs ka ru// rin chen 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin// dgos 'dod re ba skong mdzad pa// dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa ltar// dbul ba sel zhing nyon mongs 'joms// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'dus// rta glang rin chen gos dang 'bru// khrus kyi rdzing bu la sogs pa// rin chen dngos grub bdag la stsol// o gha taṃ dzam+bha sems rāg ni ma ka ra badz+ra rat+na tit+ta sarba dzaḥhūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ yid bzhin nor bu rin chen gter mdzod nas// nor lha'i rgyal po ār+ya dzam+bha la// btso ma gser mdog gzi brjid ldan// rin chen rgyan ldan phan sems can// phyag g.yas nor bu ster mdzad pa// phyag g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa nas// sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'dus// mi nor zas gos dngos grub stsol// oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ya rat+na sid+dhī dzaḥhūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ gnod sbyin rgyal po rin chen spyon// rin chen gter mdzod bdag po ste// nor bu rin chen char ltar 'bebs// bdag la nor gyi dngos grub stsol// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis// 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod dang*// bla na med pa chen po'i nor// ci 'dod phun sum tshogs pa yi// dngos grub chen po bdag la stsol// oṃ hrīḥ.a pa ra tsi ti te bdag la sid+dhi dzaḥhūm̐// gnod sbyin rgyal po gter bdag po// bzhugs pa ri rab rtse la bzhugs// thugs ni 'dzam gling kun la khyab*// sku mdog dmar ser gzi brjid la// nor rgyun ma yi yum dang bcas// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'byung po mnan// rin chen bzang po khyod la bstod// oṃ a phu yu ṇi sha ya dha ra dha ra dhi ri dhi ri swā hā/

nor lha'i rgyal po rnam thos sras// sku mdog ma nges cir yang ston// phyag mtshan mdung dang ba dan bsnams// mchod rten rin chen ne'u le 'dzin// ri rab gling bzhi mi yi bcud// rnam rgyal khang bzang nor gyis 'gengs// yid bzhin nor gyis g.yang 'bebs pa// re ba skong zhing nor rnams sbyin// zhal nas g.yang rab dam pa 'don// na mo rat+na tra yā ya// na mo bai shra ma ṇa ye ma hā rā dzā ya/ tad+ya thā/ su mu su mu/ tsan+dha tsan+dha/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ki li ki li/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ san+dha ba ye/ ad ma nam nyid tan/ an dha ra dhu ra swā hā/ na mo bai shra ma ṇa ya swā hā/ dha na dha ye swā hā/ na mo narna pa ri swā hā/ mi nor zas gsum thams cad dhi sha ma ne ye sat+na rat+na sidhi swā hā/ rin chen rgyal ba rgyas shing 'phel// sgyu ma'i bang mdzod nam mkha' mnyam// kar sha pa ṇi brgya stong phrag /nyin re bzhin du gnang bar mdzod// mi yi 'khor los sgyur ba de// mi rnams kun la mnga' brnyes pa// skye bo mang po 'phel zhing rgyas// dkon mchog yon bdag mdzad pa yi// 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po khyod// mi rnams bde dang skyid pa'i don// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'dus// rin chen sna bdun bdag la stsol// rta lha ār+ya re man+ta// rngog chags kun la dbang bsgyur zhing*// dgra lha'i mchog ste nyi ma'i sras// khyod ni dgra lha'i mched yin te// chibs su sngon po sgal nag chibs// bzhengs na stag gnyis sngon la 'gro// seng chen gnyis ni phyi na 'brang*// khyung chen gnyis ni glad la lding*// 'phrag par lcags kyi bya khra 'phur// dpal 'bar lam lha tshe bsrung zhing*// lam dang g.yul gyi dgra las rgyal// nor dang 'bru rnams 'phel ba yi// nor gyi dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la byon// 'bru rnams 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ ār+ya re man+ta gho ra sid+dhi rat+na sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/

phyugs lha kun gyi rgyal po ni// glang chen sa la rab brtan te// khyu mchog kun la mnga' mdzad pa// phyag na g.yang gi zhags pa bsnams// be'u rnam rgyal 'khor dang bcas// phyugs rnams 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyir// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'dus// phyugs kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// oṃ a ba sha rat+na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ lha rgyal ār+ya tsa muṇ+ḍi// nor srung parna sha ba ri// yo byad gyen du bsrung ba'i lha// lha dang klu dang lha ma yin// klu rgyal char 'bebs lo tog bsrung*// klu rgyal 'bru bcud spel mdzad ma// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'dus// oṃ a na sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā// hūm̐ shar gyi phyogs nas g.yang sdud pa// ma hā de wa yab sras bzhi// khro bo dkar gsal brjid pa la// phyag na dngul gyi lcags kyu bsnams// mi g.yang thams cad 'gugs par byed// g.yon na g.yu yi dril bu gsil// bar chad thams cad sel bar mdzod// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'dus// mi yi tshe g.yang brtan par mdzad// lho yi phyogs nas g.yang sdud ba// ma hā de wa sras dang bcas// khro bo ser po mi bzad pa// phyag na gser gyi phreng ba bsnams// gser dngul rin chen dbang du sdud// g.yon na g.yu yi dril bu 'dzin// gnod byed thams cad skrag par byed// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// rin chen sna bdun rgyas par mdzod// nub kyi phyogs nas g.yang sdud pa// ma hā de ba lcam dral ba// khro bo dmar po mi bzad pa// phyag na g.yang gi zhags pa bsnams// phyugs g.yang thams cad 'gugs par byed// g.yon na g.yu yi dril bu 'dzin// tshe g.yang thams cad 'gugs par byed// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren /gi wang sman mchog kun gyi dngos// ku sha byol song kun gyi gsos// yungs kar khro bo kun gyi rgyal// bdun po de yang g.yang la rten// 'khor lo rin chen gling bzhi dbang*// rta mchog rin chen sprin gyi shugs// glang po rin chen theg chen stobs// nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod re ba skong*// btsun mo rin chen bde mchog ldan// khyim bdag rin chen dgos 'dod sbyor// blon po rin chen blo gros ldan// dmag g.yang bshos tshe gtor tshe ril tshe chang mda' dar 'brang rgyas sogs dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams gtad la/ kye sngon gyi bskal ba'i dang po la// g.yang gi mi rabs mched bzhi des// gser gyi sa gzhi'i los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur// rin chen bdun la longs spyod pa'i// byin rlabs phywa dang g.yang gi stobs// byang phyogs dpal ri lhun po la// dpal gyi sba smyug ldem pa skyes// tshigs bdun tshigs dgu bcu gsum pa// 'khor los sgyur ba'i g.yang rten lags// da lta longs spyod rgyas pa yang*// bkra shis sba snyug rgyas pa de// 'khor los sgyur ba'i g.yang phur byas// rgyal po longs spyod rgyas pa ltar// de ring snyug rgod tshigs gsum pa// yon bdag 'di yi phywa g.yang lags// bkra shis phywa g.yang phur la rten// 'khor los sgyur ba'i rta phur ltar// yon bdag phywa g.yang phur la rten// g.yang mo lug gi g.yang 'di ni// ār+ya tsa maṇ+ḍa la rten// 'bras zan zhal dkar phywa g.yang rten// phyugs g.yang tshe g.yang nor g.yang rnams// hu ye hu ldan phywa ldan no// mgo nag mi yi phywa longs shig

/dud 'gro phyugs kyi g.yang khugs so// g.yang la g.yang 'brog gnag gi gang*// g.yang la g.yang 'phel lug gis gang*// g.yang la g.yang 'phel rta yis gang*// nor la g.yang 'phel bong bus gang*// nor la g.yang 'phel phyugs kyis gang*// khyim la g.yang 'phel mi yis gang*// bang mdzod g.yang 'phel 'bru yis gang*// tshe la g.yang 'phel ra yis gang*// ra ba g.yang 'phel phyugs kyis gang*// de ltar bdag la bstsal du gsol// de nas lha rnams g.yang du len// mi rje mon dkar bya ba de// de ring phywa dang g.yang du len// sras rje 'bri ldog bya ba de// de ring phywa dang g.yang du len// lha bu lha bran bya ba de// de ring phywa dang g.yang du len// da ni dpal rnams g.yang du blan// dpal gyi mda' ni li dmar la// g.yu yi nyi ma spu gri rgyas// btags par phywa dang g.yang du blan// rno mtshon sra zhing dpal du byon// de ring hu ye hu ldan no// de ring phywa ye phywa ldan no// pho lha g.yang du blan pa ni// pha ni bla rje dmar po yin// ma ni dam sri'i ma yin no// bu ni pho lha dkar po dang*// mo lha de ni dkar mo yin// de ring phywa dang g.yang du blan// da ni khyim lha g.yang du blan// pha ni spyi lha gang po dang*// ma ni spyi gtsug rgyal mo yin// bu ni khyim lha ge thung yin// de ring phywa dang g.yang du blan// de ring phywa ye phywa ldan no// de ring hu ye hu ldan no// gser gyi ka ba ma chag cig /g.yu yi gdung ma ma chag cig /mthing bu lhog lhog ma byed cig /mu ru g.yu sbrang ma zhar cig /dbyar gsum sbra la thog ma lhung*// dgun gsum gur la me ma shor// dung gi bya lag ma 'thor cig /dngul gyi chon thag ma chad cig /phyi sgo phye ba'i nang shed na// rin chen gser gyi mi bo che// gser gyi sba 'khar phyag na bsnams// nang sgo phyug mo bya ba ni// lcags kyi rten mkhar phyag na bsnams// phyi mi skya bo nang du ma btang zhig

/nang mi smug po phyi ru ma 'bud cig /lha lug gro mo thang la ma 'bud cig /srid kyi glang chen nang la ma gtong zhig /khyim lha phywa dang g.yang du blan// da ni zhing lha g.yang du blan// pha ni sprin stong yongs kyi rje// ma ni bya bzang mthong gi btsun// sras ni zhing lha pha wang yin// lo legs ljang bu'i dus nas legs// de ring zhing lha g.yang du blan// phyugs lha g.yang du blan pa na// pha ni zla bzhi phyug po yin// ma ni nyer bzhi phyug mo yin// sras ni phyug lha nyer bu yin// de ring phyug lha g.yang du len// rta yi lha ni bres po yin// 'bri yi lha ni sham po dang*// g.yag gi lha ni dung pho dang*// mdzo yi lha ni ge god dang*// lug gi lha ni man bu dang*// ra yi lha ni tsher mo rnams// de ring phywa dang g.yang du blan// thab lha g.yang du blan pa ni// pha ni btsan lha phur bu dang*// ma ni bya ldan btsun mo yin// bu ni thab lha rog po yin// de ring thab lha g.yang du blan// rgan pa rnams kyi tshe bsrings la// gzhon pa rnams kyi dpal skyed cig /de ring hu ye hu ldan no// de ring phywa ye phywa ldan no//

zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bstan srung dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod// dge 'dun sde skyong rnal 'byor tshe dpal spel// snyan pa'i dar phyor grags pa'i dung bus la// 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa nyid du mdzod// rgas med lang tsho ldan pa'i lus stobs rgyas// mig la ya mtshan ltad mo'i dga' ba dang*// rna bar rtag tu snyan pa'i gtam thos shing*// dri zhim ngad pa sna dang mi 'bral bar// zas skom 'byor bas ro 'dzin tshim byed cing*// lus la reg bya bde ba kho nas 'tsho// yid la rnam par bkra ba'i shes rab dang*// zag med bde bas nam yang ngom par mdzod// khyod gsol khyod bsten khyod mchod khyod rbad na// mthu rtsal ma chung brtse gdung che bar mdzod// gzhi la bkra shis phun tshogs longs spyod ldan// byes su lam 'phrang chu las sgrol 'don mdzod// 'jigs sar dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba skyobs// mdor na bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la// 'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen bsam don lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// ces dang*/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan shog /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod// ces dang bkra shis kyi rim pa skabs su gang bab brjod la yon bdag rang gnas su btang*/ nyer bzhi pa rjes kyi cho ga gtang rag gi tshul du bskang pa bya ba ni mchod rdzas rnams gso dran byas la/ rje chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis bstsal ba ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/

oṃ swā bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu zhing ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang 'dres par gyur ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ gzhan yang nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga bkra shis pa'i rdzas rnams dang rten rdzas sgrub rdzas mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa zag med bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ gi bar brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐ mkha' dbyings bde ba chen po'i klong// 'gyur med rang rig 'od gsal mdangs// bdud rtsi rā sa ya na dngos// mchod sprin rgya mtsho dkrigs pa 'di// bde chen zhing mgon rgyal kun dngos// tshe mtha' yas pa'i thugs dam bskang*// grub pa yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur// 'chi med pad+ma= /rgyal bas lung bstan spyod pa 'chang*// ka h+na pa yi= /bde chen mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// bzhad pa rdo rje'i= shes rab bdag nyid yum chen mo// rdo rje btsun mo'i= /gang sprul rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// nyi zla thod phreng = /legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po'i yum// dbang mo che yi= /bkra shis tshe yi dbang phyug ma// rdo rje mi 'gyur dpal gyi yum// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid// lha sman rgyal mo'i= /snang srid kun shes dbang phyug ma// rdo rje khros ma bde chen yum// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid// mthing gi zhal bzang = /dgos 'dod nor gyi dbang phyug ma// rdo rje bzhad ma 'dod sbyin yum// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid// mi g.yo blo bzang= /khams gsum dbang sdud dbang phyug ma// rdo rje dpal mo longs spyod yum// pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid// cod pan mgrin bzang= /drag po'i las kyi dbang phyug ma// rdo rje gar mkhan phrin las yum// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid// gtad dkar 'gro bzang=

yab gcig lho lha de wa dang*// yum mchog 'brog yul sman mo dang*// jo bo sga ru la sogs pa// ming po bdun gyi= /bdud mo bzhi dang gnod sbyin bzhi// sman mo bzhi dang gangs can ljongs// skyong zhing rgyal bstan spel mdzad pa'i// brtan ma bcu gnyis= /gzhan yang 'khor du gtogs pa yi// ma mo sman mo 'bum sde dang*// lha srin dregs pa yang 'khor bcas// ma lus 'khor bcas=/ rtag tu brten zhing bsgrub pa'i phyir// gangs ri'i gzugs dang dar dkar gur// mda' dar rin chen par bu sogs// rten pa'i rdzas kyis= /mchod cing dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir// dam rdzas gtor ma 'brang rgyas sman// gser skyems nyer spyod 'dod yon sogs// mchod pa'i rdzas kyis= /dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir// lha sngags ting 'dzin 'phro 'du dang*// 'pho med dga' bzhi'i rol pa dang*// mi shigs phyag rgyas= /phrin las myur du bsgrub pa'i phyir// dus su mchod bstod bskul ba dang*// bzlas pa sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor sogs// las bzhi'i las kyis= /mi 'bral 'grogs shing bkra shis phyir// dam tshig srog bzhin bsrung ba dang*// phyag rgya che dbyings bde chen dang*// dbyer med rtogs pas thugs dam bskang*// bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pas// lta sgom spyod pa dman pa dang*// bag med brtson pa g.yel ba dang*// mchod gtor dus las 'gyang ba dang*// dngos dman gtsang sbra chung ba sogs// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig la// nongs par gyur pa gang lags pa// snying nas bshags so dag tshangs stsol// chos kun gdod nas dag pa la// 'khrul mtshan mtha' dag mi dmigs phyir// bskang dang bshags bya ma mchis kyang*// rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bu yis// bskangs shing bshags pa'i rol pa 'dis// rtsa ba gsum dang khyad par du// lha sman lha tshogs dgyes gyur nas// dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol// khyad par bdag cag 'khor bcas la// dus dang dus min 'chi ba las// rnam rgyal bdud rtsi'i bcud len mchog

/'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// srid srung rigs rgyud spel ba dang*// snang gsal pra yi dngos grub dang*// rma g.yang zas kyis dngos grub dang*// bang mdzod 'bru yi dngos grub dang*// rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub dang*// gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba yi// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i sprin phung gis// bdag yid 'dod pa 'jo bar mdzod// nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang rgyas// khams gsum srid bcud dbang du bsdus// sdang dgra gdon bgegs tshar chod cig /sgrub brgyud mchog gi ring lugs 'di// nub med phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i gzis// dregs ldan mtha' dag zil gnon pa'i// rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan sgreng bar mdzod// dngos brgyud bsam sbyor mi bsrun pa'i// bstan dgra dam sri'i dpung bcas rnams// kha phung rjes med rdul du rlog /rbod gtong rang gshed rang la phob// nges don bstan pa'i snying po 'di// gang du gnas pa'i rgyal khams su// nad 'khrugs mu ge'i ming med cing*// bde skyid lo legs bkra shis mdzod// mdor na bstan 'gror sman bgyid pa'i// bdag cag rnams kyis rang gzhan don// mtha' dag gegs med myur 'grub pa'i// bkra shis mchog gi bde legs stsol// zhes brjod/ lha rdzas yid du 'ong ba yis// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang*// bdug spos snang gsal dri chab dang*// zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol bya'i phyir// dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje dang*// lha sman 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dgyes par bzhes nas bdag la dgongs// oṃ shri mān sogs nas/ shab+da 'i bar brjod/ ces dang*/ rtsa brgyud bla ma bzhad pa rdo rje dang*// rnal 'byor ma dpal yi dam mkha' 'gro ma// tshe ring mched lnga ḍā ki chos skyong rnams// thams cad ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag sogs ma rig dbang gyur nongs pa'i tshogs// chad lhag nor 'khrul gtor mchod dman pa dang*// dam tshig mi ldan gsang ba smras pa sogs// mthol lo bshags so bzod par bzhes su gsol// bla ma dam pas byin gyis rlob pa dang*// yi dam lha yi dngos grub stsol mdzad cing*// chos skyong srung mas bar chad sel ba dang*// bstan pa dar zhing bkra shis chos 'phel shog

/sangs rgyas bstan srung dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod// dge 'dun sde skyong rnal 'byor tshe dpal spel// snyan pa'i dar phyor grags pa'i dung bus la// 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa nyid du mdzod// rgas med lang tsho ldan pa'i lus stobs ldan// mig la ya mtshan ltad mo'i dga' ba dang*// rna bar rtag tu snyan pa'i gtam thos shing*// dri zhim ngad pa sna dang mi 'bral bar// zas skom 'byor pas ro 'dzin tshim byed cing*// lus la reg bya bde ba kho nas 'tsho// yid la rnam par bkra ba'i shes rab dang*// zag med bde bas nam yang ngom par mdzod// khyod gsol khyod bsten khyod mchod khyod rbad na// mthu rtsal ma chung brtse gdung che bar mdzod// gzhi la bkra shis phun tshogs longs spyod ldan// byes su lam 'phrang chu la sgrol 'don mdzod// 'jigs sar dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba skyob// mdor na bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// ces dang*/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// der 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan shog /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod// lha rnams nongs pa gang mchis bzod par bzhes// rang gnas gshegs sam rten la ci bder bzhugs// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs tshogs// gong nas gong du 'phel pa'i bkra shis shog / ces brjod cing*/ nyer lnga pa yi dam gyi rjes chog gi rim pa la mchod pa kha gsos la/ oṃ āḥbighān gyis bsangs/ swā bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā lar// yangs shing rgya che rnams kyi nang du hūm̐// dpag med 'od zhu'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i// rdo rje'i mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas sgra snyan sogs// dwangs shing thogs med mkha' dbyings gang bar gyur// oṃ shrī badz+ra wā ra hī badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā// puṣ+pe/

nas/ shab+da 'i bar dang*/ pañca a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ma taṃ gi āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod cing*/ bstod pa ni/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can// khams gsum po yi ngo bo nyid// bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar pa'i 'od// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'dud// bde ba'i rang bzhin ma skyes pa// ci bzhin nyid du rtogs gyur pas// gzhan don mthar phyin mdzad pa yi// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal 'dud// bde gshegs sku la gnyis med dang*// zag med bde bas sku nyams brtas// sems can rnams la bde ster ma// phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod de/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid bstsal ba// de kun mgon la bzod par gsol// gang yang bdag blo rmongs gyur pas// legs spyad 'di la nyer gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// de kun mgon khyod bzod par gsol// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang*// de sras rnams dang tshangs la sogs// 'jig rten skyong rnams cho ga 'di'i// ma tshangs ma dag bzod par gsol// zhes nongs pa bshags shing yig brgya brjod/ thal mo sbyar bas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab cing*/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang mchog tu tshad ma ste// bden pa de yis lha mo mchog gis ni// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cing*// rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i shu kra mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad sdig med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi// sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad par shog /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis grol// da lta nyid du rjes brtse bas// rnal 'byor bstan bcos gnas la dgod//

ces dang*/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid pa// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// zhes rgyun par dang*/ grol dus/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs nas kyang*// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra mu= / zhes ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs nas dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying ka'i gnas su oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsdu/ phyi rol snod bcud rten gzhal yas khang 'khor dang bcas pa bdag nyid la 'dus/ bdag nyid kyang spyi bo dang zhabs mthil nas 'dus te/ gsang gnas kyi sngags 'khor dang hrīḥl thim/ de yang thig le dang nā da las 'das nas don dam stong pa nyid do// zhes ci gnas su bzhag / slar yang de nyid kyi ngang las stong bzhin du nye bar snang ba sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyi khyad par byas pa'i zung 'jug gzugs kyi sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa sku mdog dmar mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa gsal bar gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yi dam lha tshogs 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / bkra shis ni/ chos dbyings mkha' la rgyal dang rgyal sras kyi// rgyu skar sna tshogs dbus na ri bong can// 'chi med tshe yi cha shas yongs gang ba'i// mgon po tshe dpag med kyi bkra shis shog /grub pa'i bcud len mchog gi ro myong bas// 'pho med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub cing*// grub pa brgyad kyi nor gyis yongs su 'byor// rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i bkra shis shog /stong dang snying rje zung 'jug rol rtsal las// 'phags bzhi skyed yum mkha' 'dra'i chos kyi sku// pra phab lta bur gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi bkra shis shog

/dag pa gnyis ldan zung 'jug bde ba che// mngon du byas te sgrub brgyud ring lugs mchog /phyogs bcur spel phyir 'jig rten ḍā ki'i tshul// tshe 'dzin lha mo lnga yi bkra shis shog /gnas 'dir nyin mor bde legs mtshan bde legs// sogs brjod cing me tog 'thor/ bum chu btung zhing sin+dhu ra gnas gsum du byug /lhag ma tshags bya zhing g.yang rdzas rnams phyi la mi 'khyar ba bya/ gzhan don yin na g.yang gtad dus sbyin bdag pho mo bos nas g.yang rdzas gtad pa'i gong du grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bskur ba dang*/ khyad par bla med dam tshig can la ḍā ki lnga yi bka' gtad chags med rin po che'i dbang chog ltar bskur kyang legs shing spyi la ni de dag khrom chos su mi rung ba yang gnad kyi zhal gdams dang*/ dus mchod ltar gtso mo lnga'i gtor ma dang*/ 'bul gtor tsam la brten nas bsdus te 'don par spro na bdag bskyed bla ma yi dam gyi bskyed bzlas tshar nas tshe ring ma'i mngon rtogs nas bzung mthar chags su 'don cing*/ g.yang 'gugs rnams bzhag /rjes chog kyang de mtshungs bsal 'don zhes par byas kyang chog go// 'di yi dam tshig tu bla ma mi la'i bka' brgyud yi dam lhan cig skyes ma/ bka' srung lha sman rgyal mo rnams srog la thug rung mi 'dor ba'i ci mdzad khyed shes kyis blo bkal ba dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i dran pa rgyun chags shin tu gal che zhing*/ de ltar dam tshig dang ldan par bsgrub na/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ yi dam sgom bzlas/ tshe sgrub/ nor sgrub sogs dgos pa thams cad tshang bas brgyud pa 'di yi rjes 'jug rnams kyis gces spras su bya bar rigs so// ces pa'ang*/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos/ dbon bsam gtan sprul pa'i sku karma theg mchog nges don bstan 'phel gyi thugs bzhed ltar/ rje karma chags med rin po che'i lung gzhir byas nas gsal bar bkod pa bkra shis mi nub bstan pa dar rgyas 'gro la bde skyid phan bde'i dpal du shog
